| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `getApplet()` | Deprecated. |
| `getClientVersion()` | Returns the current DreamBot client version |
| `getDiscordWebhook()` | Gets the user's Discord webhook URL |
| `getProxyName()` | Gets the client's proxy nickname, null if no proxy selected |
| `getRandomManager()` | Gets the current script's random manager, or null if script manager/current script are null. |
| `isClientOutdated()` | Checks if the currently running client is outdated. |
| `isDeveloperModeActive()` | Checks to see if the client's Developer Mode is active |
| `minimize()` | This method minimizes (dock) the whole DreamBot program |
| `setDisableDebugging(boolean disabled)` | Disables debugging tools and logs. |
| `setDisableGameExplorer(boolean disabled)` | Sets whether the Game Explorer window can be opened and used or not. |
| `setForceDisableMouseInput(boolean disabled)` | Forces no human mouse input allowed |
| `setForcePaint(boolean disabled)` | Forces showing the script paint, ignores user settings. |
| `show()` | This method will un-minimize and bring the whole DreamBot program to the front of your desktop |
